results.description:
## Patliputra University (PPU) UG Regular Result
Patliputra University, Patna dwara Undergraduate (BA, BSc, BCom) Part-3 / Semester Results jaari kar diye gaye hain. Students session aur roll number choose karke marksheet download kar sakte hain.
results.extraContent:
### PPU Result Check Karne Ka Tarika:
1. Session select karein (e.g. 2025-2026 ya Year).
2. Exam Type me 'Regular' ya 'Vocational' choose karein.
3. Course me apna Stream select karein (BA / BSc / BCom).
4. Roll Number aur Father/Mother ka naam enter karein aur 'Show Marksheet' par click karein.
results.label: UG BA, BSc, BCom Examination
results.title: PPU UG (BA/BSc/BCom) Result
